from pathlib import Path
import ast
import re

files = sorted(Path('.').glob('*.c')) + [Path('common.h')]
lex = re.compile(r'\\s+|//["'^'"\\n]*|/\\*.*?\\*/|\"(?:\\\\.|["'^"'"\\\\])*\"|\\'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"\\'\\\\])*\\'|[A-Za-z_]\\w*|.', re.S)
all_tokens = {}
for p in files:
    tokens = [m.group() for m in lex.finditer(p.read_text()) if not m.group().isspace() and not m.group().startswith(('//', '/*'))]
    stack = []
    for token in tokens:
        if token in ('(', '[', '{'): stack.append(token)
        elif token in (')', ']', '}'):
            assert stack and stack.pop() == {')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{'}[token], (p, token)
    assert not stack, (p, stack)
    all_tokens[p.name] = tokens
print('C delimiters balanced in all seven implementations and common.h.')

for p in files:
    if p.name == 'common.h': continue
    old = (Path('.before') / p.name).read_text()
    new = p.read_text()
    if p.name "'!= '"'common.c':
        old_help = re.search(r'static void usage\\(void\\) \\{\\s*printf\\((.*?), program\\);\\s*\\}', old, re.S).group(1)
        new_help = re.search(r'static const char help\\[\\] =\\s*(.*?);', new, re.S).group(1)
        strings = lambda text: ''.join(ast.literal_eval(s) for s in re.findall(r'\"(?:\\\\.|["'^"'"\\\\])*\"', text))
        assert strings(old_help).replace('Usage: %s ', '', 1) == strings(new_help), p
        if p.name "'!= '"'find.c':
            opts = re.search(r'getopt_long\\(argc, argv, \"(["'^"]*)"'"', old).group(1)
            assert re.search(r'next_option\\(argc, argv, \"(["'^"]*)"'"', new).group(1) == opts, p
            old_cases = set(re.findall(r\"case ('(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'])+'):\", old))
            new_cases = set(re.findall(r\"case ('(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'])+'):\", new))
            assert old_cases == new_cases, p
print('Help text, option strings, and option cases match the originals.')

arity = {'usage': 2, 'next_option': 4, 'error_path': 2, 'read_entry': 3, 'close_dir': 2, 'remove_tree': 2, 'copy_tree': 2, 'parse': 1}
for name, tokens in all_tokens.items():
    for i, token in enumerate(tokens[:-1]):
        if token not in arity or tokens[i + 1] "'!= '"'(': continue
        nesting, commas, j = 1, 0, i + 2
        while nesting:
            t = tokens[j]
            if t == '(': nesting += 1
            elif t == ')': nesting -= 1
            elif t == ',' and nesting == 1: commas += 1
            j += 1
        assert commas + 1 == arity[token], (name, token, commas + 1)
print('Changed helper declarations, definitions, and calls have consistent argument counts.')

combined = '\\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in files)
for obsolete in ('init_program', 'parse_and', 'parse_or'):
    assert not re.search(r'\\b' + obsolete + r'\\b', combined), obsolete
assert 'tests.py' not in Path('Makefile').read_text()
print('No references remain to removed functions or the absent tests.py.')
'@ | python -"
